featured_reviews.name: Bhavika Kaklotar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I strongly request everyone not to visit this place.

We ordered a fruit bowl costing around ₹300 for our 10-month-old baby, assuming that under a brand name, the quality would be good and premium. Unfortunately, this assumption turned out to be completely false.

I clearly requested their staff not to add any tangy fruits, yet they still added orange, which was extremely sour—so much so that even adults could not eat it.

The rest of the fruits, including apple and papaya, were in very poor condition and not fresh at all.

Overall, the fruit quality was extremely low—worse than what is usually offered by street vendors. This was a very disappointing and unacceptable experience, especially when it involved food for an infant.

featured_reviews.name: Andy B
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located at top level of Oberio Mall sandwiched between Burger King & Taco Bell, it is a small outlets but commands it's own patron.

The selling point is health. But don't be surprised if you don't get your desired drink. This is what happened to us. We wanted avocado juice, but to our dismay there weren't any. Neither were there any notification that specific drinks are not available.

We settled for grapes and berry juice. For the taste, we think there were added sugar to enhance the taste. But good enough. They ask you beforehand if you want ice added or not. Stick to seasonal fruits & vegetables.

Experience: A very disinterested person took our order with short responses. It took about 3 to 5 min on a weekday for my order. Straws provided are sealed (+ point). They accept cash, paytm and cards.

If you’re always stuck between clean eating and comfort food, Juice Factory Andheri is your answer!

featured_reviews.name: DNB Travel & Food Reviews
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Visited Bunty Juice Center – One of the Most Famous Juice & Snack Spots in Borivali

Visited Bunty Juice Center in Borivali West and had a really enjoyable experience. This place is very popular for its huge variety of juices, shakes, desserts, sandwiches, and snacks with unique presentation style.

🍹 Food & Drinks:
The menu is extremely creative with interesting names and unique serving style. Must-try items include Gabbar Mango Shake, Kiwi Strawberry Juice, Chocolate Thali, Strawberry Cream, Festival Pizza, Chowpatty Sandwich, and Jungli Sandwich. Taste was fresh, flavorful, and presentation was eye-catching.

🍨 Desserts & Presentation:
Desserts and shakes are one of the biggest highlights here. The presentation is very different and trendy, which makes it fun especially for youngsters and families.

💰 Price:
Approx ₹250–₹500 per person depending on your order. Some items feel slightly premium priced, but quantity and creativity balance it well.

🏠 Ambience:
The place has colorful interiors, vibrant atmosphere, and cozy seating. It is usually crowded in evenings and weekends because of its popularity.

👨‍🍳 Staff & Service:
Staff is generally helpful and service is quick even during rush hours. They also guide properly if you are confused by the large menu.

🚗 Parking:
Parking can be difficult during peak time because the area gets crowded. Better to visit slightly early in evenings. They have Velvet parking facility too.

🧼 Cleanliness:
Overall cleanliness is decent considering the heavy crowd, though seating gets busy during peak hours.

📌 Overall:
Great place for juices, desserts, and innovative snacks with fun presentation. Perfect hangout spot for friends and family in Borivali.

Highly recommended 👍

featured_reviews.review_text: Bunty’s Juice Centre is well known for its unique juices. I tried their chocolate brownie milkshake. It had brownie pieces. Even the mango shake was really nice and thick with mango pieces. But the place is very chaotic. The staff forget about the order.

featured_reviews.name: Girlbehindthebrands
featured_reviews.review_text:
When Juices Steal the Show & Food Blows Your Mind! 🍹🍕🔥
Hidden in the heart of Borivali, Bunty’s Snacks & Juice Center is an absolute delight for anyone who loves experimenting with new flavours! 😍

Let’s start with the juices — honestly, they stole the show! From the tangy twist of Captain Juice to the vibrant, colourful Rangoli Juice, each one is refreshing and full of unique blends. The Salaar Juice packs a real punch — bold, chilled, and energizing — while Darna Mana Hai Juice is a fun, must-try surprise for brave hearts! 🥤

Moving to food, every bite is pure comfort. The Humpty Dumpty Toast is a crunchy, cheesy treat that instantly wins you over. The Festival Pizza truly lives up to its name — loaded, flavourful, and festive in every bite! 🍕 The Nachni Bhel is a healthy yet tasty twist, and the Gol Gappa Kabab is a total showstopper — chatpata, crunchy, and bursting with flavour!

And just when you think it can’t get better, the Strawberry Cream and Film City Dessert arrive to seal the deal — creamy, dreamy, and picture-perfect endings! 🍓🍨

If you’re in Borivali and haven’t been here yet, you’re missing out on a local gem. Great taste, quick service, and a vibe that makes you want to come back again and again

featured_reviews.name: kajol patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bunty Cafe is a charming establishment that offers both indoor air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating, allowing guests to enjoy their meals in a setting that suits their preference. One of the standout features of this cafe is its popular range of juices, which are served in a visually appealing and creative way. The presentation adds an extra touch to the overall experience, making it more enjoyable.

A particular highlight was the Chaupati Sandwich, which was full of flavor and left a lasting impression. However, the pasta was a bit of a disappointment. Instead of the expected pasta sauce, it had a taste resembling a paneer gravy, which was not quite what one would expect from a pasta dish.

For dessert, the Strawberry Cream was quite delightful, offering a nice balance of sweetness and freshness. Additionally, the cafe offers a variety of funky juices, each presented with a unique setup that adds to the overall appeal. Although the juice setups are quite fancy, the juices themselves are priced higher than expected, but they remain fairly average in terms of taste.

The ambience of the cafe is simple and unassuming, but it provides a comfortable space for conversations and casual hangouts. It's a great spot for a relaxed chit-chat with friends or family, making it an ideal place to spend time with loved ones over a refreshing drink.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Amar Juice Centre, a place I’d heard quite a bit about—especially for its pav bhaji.

I tried the butter pav bhaji and a mango shake. To be honest, the pav bhaji didn’t quite live up to the hype for me. It was decent, but nothing particularly memorable, and it didn’t really satisfy that nostalgic craving for authentic Mumbai-style pav bhaji that I was hoping for.

The mango shake, however, was the standout. It was fresh, flavorful, and easily the highlight of the visit.

The setup is pretty straightforward—located right on the main road, with a stand-and-eat format. You can also enjoy your food in your parked car, which is quite convenient. The staff was courteous, and the service was impressively quick, which adds to the overall ease of the experience.

Overall, Amar Juice Centre is worth a stop for its juices and quick bites, but if you're going in with high expectations for the pav bhaji, you might find it a bit underwhelming.

Modern Juice Center is an absolute gem if you’re craving flavor-packed shawarmas and juicy, satisfying burgers! 🌯🍔
Their shawarma is perfectly spiced, loaded with tender meat, and wrapped just right — every bite hits with bold, Middle Eastern-inspired flavors. The burgers? Super juicy, cheesy, and loaded with all the good stuff.

Pair it with one of their fresh juices or thick shakes, and you’ve got yourself a complete, lip-smacking meal.

Great taste, quick service, and pocket-friendly prices — what more can you ask for? A must-try spot for street-style cravings done right! 🔥

featured_reviews.name: Mufaddal Patanwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked in the bustling lanes of Colaba, Modern Juice Centre has quietly become one of my most reliable late-night go-to spots. Whenever post-10 pm cravings kick in, this place is almost always on my mind—mainly because it stays open late and never disappoints.

My absolute top picks here are the mulberry juice and tender coconut drink. The mulberry juice has a rich, slightly tangy sweetness that feels both refreshing and indulgent at the same time, while the tender coconut is as clean and hydrating as it gets—perfect balance after a long day.

When it comes to food, their sandwiches and shorma are my default add-ons. The sandwiches are crisp, well-filled, and consistently satisfying, while the shorma is simple but hits the spot, especially late at night when you want something filling yet not too heavy.

What makes this place special is its reliability—you know exactly what you’ll get every single time. No fancy setup, no frills—just good food, quick service, and the comfort of knowing it’s there when most places have shut down. For late-night hunger in South Mumbai, this spot is hard to beat.
